column1: # Shared boolean-flag vectors for GPY_* environment switches. `1/true/yes/on`
# is on and `0/false/no/off` is off, case-insensitive, surrounding whitespace
# ignored; anything else counts as unset (the caller's default applies).
#     shell_env_flag_shared_vectors), the one parser of every GPY_* flag,
# Format: one vector per line, tab-separated: value<TAB>state (on|off|unset).
